title: Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Association (TSA) at Texas A&M University is a registered student organization serving Taiwanese students at one of the largest public universities in the United States. The organization is listed on the university’s official Get Involved club directory and maintains an active presence on campus. Its Chinese name, 德州農工大學台灣同學會, reflects its identity as a self-governing association formed by students from Taiwan.

The TSA’s stated mission encompasses three core goals: promoting awareness of Taiwan’s culture, history, politics, society, and economics; fostering understanding and friendship between Taiwanese and students of other nationalities; and providing fellowship and services for Taiwanese students at TAMU. To that end, the organization holds activities including lectures, seminars, dinner parties, and camping trips, and participates in broader international student events such as Mini-Olympics and International Week.

The TSA maintains an official website and a Facebook community group (facebook.com/taiwantamu), and has historically produced a student handbook (hosted via Google Sites) to assist incoming Taiwanese students with the transition to life in College Station. The organization’s advocacy efforts have included engagement with the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Houston on issues related to Taiwan’s international standing.
